sequence.present_surface: returned normally, which runs IDXGISwapChain::Present through slot 0x40

what_this_proves: the renderer plugin in our host is a real, usable Direct3DDevice11
the primary surface (swapchain) can be created against an EWindow we built
the frame bracket BeginFrame .. PresentSurface executes without fault
the shipped renderer presented a frame to a real window in our process
what_it_does_not_prove: that anything is drawn in that frame beyond whatever Clear state the device had
that terrain or a character can be drawn
that the D3D11 device inside the plugin was fully initialised by CreateDevice, since BeginFrame and PresentSurface tolerate an empty frame
boundary: The host published the engine global and drove these calls. Presentation came from the shipped renderer, not from a reimplementation.
